topic: Claude in Chrome: hand off a repetitive browser task, safely
post:
Spend your lunch break clicking through the same 5 websites? 🖱️
Claude in Chrome can do that browsing for you.

Claude in Chrome is an extension that lets Claude work inside your Chrome browser: reading pages, clicking and filling in forms, with your permission.

Get started 👇
1️⃣ Install it from the Chrome Web Store
2️⃣ Sign in with your Claude account
3️⃣ Review and grant the permissions it asks for

Then try a low-risk task first:
"Open these 3 product pages, and make me a table comparing price, delivery time and return policy. Don't buy anything or fill in any forms."

Safe habits ✅
🔒 Start with read-only tasks, like comparing or summarizing
👀 Watch what it does the first few times
🛑 Stop it if anything looks off, and never let it handle passwords for you

📌 Claude in Chrome is on paid plans (Pro, Max, Ultra, Team and Enterprise). It works in Chrome only, not other browsers or phones.

Why it matters:
The most boring part of many jobs is copying things between websites. That's exactly what you can hand off. 💡

What website chore would you hand off first? 👇

Follow me: I'm teaching one Claude skill a day, no tech background needed.
